description: Election Commission - Declare that A. G. S. Renuka as a Member of the Welivitiya - Divithura P/S
categorisation: This gazette content specifically addresses the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Welivitiya - Divithura Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It deals with electoral processes, including the resignation of a member, nomination by a political party, and declaration of a new member to fill the vacancy. This falls squarely under Election Gazettes (Type 7) as it concerns electoral matters and local authority elections procedures.
